So the interaction model is:
1. Click on a bottom colored square to select it (white border appears)
2. Then do something to place it
Now I need to figure out what to do next. Let me try:
- Clicking on a gray block in the middle to place the selected color there
- Or pressing SPACE to confirm/place it

        if n['id'] >= 20:
            print(f"  id={n['id']}, color={n['color']}, pixels={n['pixels']}")
else:
    print("No board change")
